eip3091.label: EIP-3091
eip3091.proven: etherscan, blockscout, routescan and every fork; also mempool.space, Solana Explorer, viewblock

blocks-transactions-accounts.label: Plural paths
blocks-transactions-accounts.proven: mintscan, proven against cosmos/chain-registry's own block_page/tx_page/account_page strings

block-extrinsic-account.label: Subscan (Substrate)
block-extrinsic-account.proven: subscan — Substrate has extrinsics rather than transactions, so the tx template takes an extrinsic hash

block-txn-account.label: Aptos Explorer
block-txn-account.proven: explorer.aptoslabs.com — the tx template takes a transaction version

ledger-tx-account.label: Ledger-based
ledger-tx-account.proven: xrpscan, stellar.expert — a ledger sequence is this family's block height

block-tx-contract.label: Starkscan
block-tx-contract.proven: starkscan — accounts are contracts on Starknet

hash-routed.label: Hash-routed SPA
hash-routed.proven: tronscan — client-side routing puts every path behind a #, which is part of the URL the browser needs

root-path.label: Single-namespace
root-path.proven: tzkt — one root namespace resolves levels, operation hashes and addresses alike

home.label: Home page only
home.proven: n/a — the explorer exists but no deep-link shape has been verified for it. explorerUrl() returns null for every ref and only the home URL is offered. This is a terminal state, not a TODO: an honest home link beats a deep link that 404s.
